title: Peter Ibbetson
author: George Du Maurier
description: "Peter Ibbetson" by George Du Maurier is a semi-autobiographical novel written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The narrative presents the life story of its protagonist, Peter Ibbetson, a man sentenced to life imprisonment for murder, who later finds himself in a lunatic asylum, where he writes his memoirs.

authorInfo.bio: George Du Maurier (1834–1896) wrote Peter Ibbetson. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
